title: Session 6 lab exercise: Survival Analysis part 1
text: dataset, time weeks relapse censoring, cens event indicator: 1 patient relapsed 0 censored. Despite name, cens = 1 means event, censored observation. set Placebo reference group. Surv() combines time event status single outcome. Censored times printed +:
code: library(tidyverse) library(survival) library(survminer) leuk <- read_csv("leuk.csv") %>%   mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Placebo", "6 MP"))) table(leuk$group, leuk$cens) ##           ##            0  1 ##   Placebo  0 21 ##   6 MP    12  9 with(leuk, Surv(time, cens)) ##  [1]  6   6   6   7  10  13  16  22  23   6+  9+ 10+ 11+ 17+ 19+ 20+ 25+ 32+ 32+ ## [20] 34+ 35+  1   1   2   2   3   4   4   5   5   8   8   8   8  11  11  12  12  ## [39] 15  17  22  23

what: Plot the Kaplan-Meier estimate for both groups
title: Session 6 lab exercise: Survival Analysis part 1
code: fit <- survminer::surv_fit(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk) survminer::ggsurvplot(fit,            xlab = "Time (weeks)",            ylab = "Survival Probability",            risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.col = "strata")

what: Perform a log-rank test comparing the two groups
title: Session 6 lab exercise: Survival Analysis part 1
code: survdiff(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk) ## Call: ## survdiff(formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk) ##  ##                N Observed Expected (O-E)^2/E (O-E)^2/V ## group=Placebo 21       21     10.7      9.77      16.8 ## group=6 MP    21        9     19.3      5.46      16.8 ##  ##  Chisq= 16.8  on 1 degrees of freedom, p= 4e-05

title: Session 6 lab exercise: Survival Analysis part 1
text: Suppose instructed cap follow-times 20 weeks. Anyone still event-free 20 weeks becomes censored 20 weeks, events 20 weeks longer counted. Kaplan-Meier plot:  Log-rank test:
code: leuknew <- leuk %>%   mutate(newtime = pmin(time, 20)) %>%   mutate(newcens = ifelse(time <= 20, cens, 0)) fit20 <- survminer::surv_fit(Surv(newtime, newcens) ~ group, data = leuknew) survminer::ggsurvplot(fit20,            xlab = "Time (weeks)",            ylab = "Survival Probability",            risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.col = "strata") survdiff(Surv(newtime, newcens) ~ group, data = leuknew) ## Call: ## survdiff(formula = Surv(newtime, newcens) ~ group, data = leuknew) ##  ##                N Observed Expected (O-E)^2/E (O-E)^2/V ## group=Placebo 21       19       10      8.05        14 ## group=6 MP    21        7       16      5.05        14 ##  ##  Chisq= 14  on 1 degrees of freedom, p= 2e-04
